title: SAFETY comment in lmdb/lib.rs references a non-existent Arc wrapper
description: lmdb/src/lib.rs:59: 'users who need multiple references should clone the Arc wrapping this type'. LmdbBlockDb has no Arc inside it; the Arc is added externally (Arc<LmdbBlockDb>) by callers. A reader seeing this comment will expect to find Clone or Arc<> in the type definition. The comment should say: 'wrap this value in an Arc at the call site to share it across tasks'.
